title: Research Index & Cross-Reference System
purpose: Provide a unified map of the structured January 6 records without treating cross-reference as proof of causation, motive, guilt, or legal responsibility.

record_families.name: Evidence Ledger
record_families.description: Primary sources, official records, government findings, court findings and later developments.

record_families.name: Claim Tracker
record_families.description: Major claims separated from the evidence used to assess them.

record_families.name: Timeline & Event Record
record_families.description: Chronology with stable event identifiers and linked evidence.

record_families.name: Security, Intelligence & Response
record_families.description: Warnings, intelligence processing, requests, authorization, mobilization and operational response.

record_families.name: Investigations, Courts & Legal Record
record_families.description: Congressional proceedings, prosecutions, judicial rulings, dispositions and clemency.

record_families.name: Voices & Testimony Record
record_families.description: Sworn testimony, direct observations, interviews, communications and conflicting accounts.

record_families.name: Citizen Analysis Record
record_families.description: Structured civic questions that connect claims to supporting, contrary and unresolved evidence.

cross_reference_rules: A shared identifier or link shows relevance, not automatic corroboration.
Chronological sequence does not by itself establish causation or intent.
Congressional findings, judicial holdings, allegations and executive clemency remain distinct categories.
Witness recollection should be compared with contemporaneous records and independently established facts.
Later developments should update current legal or factual understanding without erasing procedural history.
